INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.

2. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

3. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

4. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.

6. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

7. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

9. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
